title: pilosella prussica subsp. eisbergensis
intro: Pilosella prussica subsp. eisbergensis, commonly known as a plant in the dandelion family, is a subspecies of Pilosella prussica. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and is traditionally employed to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pilosella prussica subsp. eisbergensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
